subject: Mobile Development
title: The App Store Opens
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The App Store Opens.

hook.text: In July 2008, Apple launched the App Store with just 500 apps.

buildup.text: For the first time, any developer could build software and sell it to millions of users.

discovery.text: Within three days, users downloaded over 10 million apps. Apple took a 30% cut of every sale.

twist.text: Fart apps and flashlight tools flooded the store. Quality control was nearly nonexistent.

climax.text: The App Store created an entirely new economy. Today it generates over $80 billion per year.

punchline.text: Five hundred apps started an $80 billion economy.

quiz.question: How many apps did the App Store launch with?
